sources.title: TheREZOR/TinyDecide · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Try it in your browser · Quick start · Benchmarks TinyDecide reads one message and answers any number of questions about it. You write the questions in plain English when you call it. It returns a probability for every answer and does not generate text, so one encoder pass answers every question at once. The whole model is 6.2 MB.

sources.title: GitHub - therezor/cardputer-ai: Fully offline tiny LLM chatbot on the ...
sources.snippet: Made by REZOR (@therezor). How the media was made: the screens come from the firmware's own UI and chat code, run in a pixel-exact simulator with the real embedded model. Every step is timed at the measured on-device speed. The bot's words are unedited model output. We picked the best random seed per scene, just like picking the best take.

But a handful of models have changed that conversation completely, they're small enough to run locally, capable enough to outperform models like GPT-4o on specific tasks.
